svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.23.9.4 Strapping, Bridging, Furring and Ceilings in Span Tables 9.23.4.2.-A and -B
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.9.4 Strapping, Bridging, Furring and Ceilings in Span Tables 9.23.4.2.-A and -B
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Strapping, Bridging, Furring and Ceilings in Span Tables 9.23.4.2.-A and -B

g.text: Fastened at each end to a sill or
Strapping 19 × 64 or larger, nailed to the
Strapping under the floor joists, Span Table 9.23.4.2.-A
Ceiling 12.7 mm or thicker on 19 × 89 furring

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as permitted by Sentence (5), where strapping is
specified in Span Table 9.23.4.2.-A, it is
(a) not less than 19 mm by 64 mm, nailed to the underside of floor
joists, (b) located not more than 2 100 mm from each support or other
rows of strapping, and (c) fastened at each end to a sill or header.
Where bridging is specified in Span Table 9.23.4.2.-A, it
consists of not less than 19 mm by 64 mm or 38 mm by 38 mm cross
bridging located not more than 2 100 mm from each support or
other rows of bridging.
Where bridging and strapping are specified in Span Table
(a) bridging (i) complies with Sentence (2), or (ii) consists of 38 mm
solid blocking not more than 2 100 mm from each support or other rows
of bridging, securely fastened between the joists, and (b) except as
provided in Sentence (5), strapping complies with Sentence (1) and is
installed under the bridging.
Bridging specified in Span Table 9.23.4.2.-B consists of
(a) bridging as described in Sentence (2), or (b) 38 mm solid blocking
not more than 2 100 mm from each support or other rows of bridging,
securely fastened between the joists.
Strapping described in Sentence (1) and Clause (3)(b) is not
required where
(a) furring strips complying with Table 9.29.3.1. are fastened
directly to the joists, or (b) a panel-type ceiling finish complying
attached directly to the joists.
Where a ceiling attached to wood furring is specified in Span
(a) the ceiling finish is gypsum board, plywood or OSB not less than
12.7 mm thick, and (b) the furring is (i) 19 mm by 89 mm at not more
than 600 mm o.c., or (ii) 19 mm by 64 mm at not more than 400 mm o.c.
Drawn: strapping, bridging, blocking and furring in yellow, hidden strap edges dashed. A: 4 m span, one row of strapping at mid-span, illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.9.4. (page 9-180)
